checkInMessage.body:
Hello {username}!

I hope this message finds you well. I'm writing to update you on your project, [Project Name]. I'm happy to share that we are progressing smoothly and I am eager for you to see the initial results.

As of now, I have completed the following stages:
1- <please add details here>
2- <please add details here>
3- <please add details here>

I invite you to review my progress and offer feedback to make sure we're on the right track.

Revision guidelines:
Before you review my work, I want to clarify our revision policy to ensure a clear and efficient process moving forward:

- Included revisions: As outlined in our agreement, this project includes {number} rounds of revisions. These revisions are intended to refine and improve the initial work based on your feedback.

- Scope of revisions: Revisions typically cover minor adjustments such as <please add details here>. It's important to note that revisions do not cover complete overhauls or changes in project direction.

- Additional revisions: If further revisions are required beyond the included rounds, I am happy to accommodate them. Please note that additional revisions may be subject to extra charges and could impact the project timeline. I can provide a quote and adjusted timeline if needed.

- Feedback timing: Timely feedback is crucial for maintaining the project schedule. I kindly request that you provide your input within 3 business days of receiving this update.

Next steps:
Upon receiving your feedback, I will proceed with the next stages, keeping in mind any modifications you suggest. My goal is to ensure that the final product aligns perfectly with your vision and exceeds your expectations.

I am committed to delivering high-quality work that meets your needs, and I am here to support you through every step of this journey. If you have any questions or need further clarification on any aspect of the project, please do not hesitate to reach out.

Thank you for your collaboration, trust, and the opportunity to work on this exciting project. I look forward to your feedback and to continuing our productive partnership.

Best regards,
%{sellername}

Hello {username}!

I hope this message finds you well.
I am pleased to inform you that I have completed the first draft of [Project Name].
I have attached the draft for your review. Here's a brief overview of what has been done so far:

[Highlight 1]: <please add details here>
[Highlight 2]: <please add details here>
[Highlight 3]: <please add details here>

Your feedback is crucial at this stage. Please review the draft and let me know if there are any adjustments or changes you would like to make. Here are a few questions to guide your review:

- Does the draft align with your vision and goals for the project?
- Are there any specific elements you feel need revision or improvement?
- Is there any additional information or clarification you require?

Once I receive your feedback, I will make the necessary revisions to ensure the final product meets your expectations.
My goal is to deliver work that you are completely satisfied with.

Thank you for the opportunity to work on this project. I look forward to your thoughts and suggestions.

Best regards,

followUp.body:
Hi {username}!

How are you?

yes.body:
Hello {username}!

I’m excited to help you achieve your project goals.
Once we’ve agreed on terms (package, timeline, required assets, etc.) and your order is placed, I’ll get started with the first step in my work process. If you would like, we can start by scheduling an online meeting. The time stated in the package is usually the time that will take me to submit my best results.

Please be mindful that the more information you share with me at this stage, the better I can meet your needs. Once your order has been placed, changes may incur an additional fee and/or affect the deadline.

Throughout the process, I will update you on the status of your project to ensure that we are aligned on its direction.

Generally, I send drafts to my clients before submitting the final delivery. The sooner you can review my work and provide feedback, the sooner I’ll be able to move forward and make any necessary adjustments.

Don't hesitate to reach out if you have questions or want to further discuss your expectations. I am here to assist you every step of the way.
Looking forward to working together!

Best regards,

common_questions.description_1: Registering your business and adding team members is free. You only pay for the services you order—just like on Fiverr.
common_questions.description_2: You can get a shortlist of handpicked freelancers from a dedicated Business Success Manager or just post a brief.
common_questions.description_3: Nope! A single account can be made for and shared by multiple users. Whether you’re working solo or collaborating with others, our vetted talent is available for all.
common_questions.description_4: Once you switch to a Fiverr Business account, it becomes your only default account. Everything will move with you, including previous searches, saved freelancers and inbox messages.
common_questions.description_5: Your existing balance will be refunded to your original payment method and your order history will move with you.
common_questions.description_6: Of course! You can deactivate your Fiverr Business account and go back to the Fiverr account. All of your information will be transferred as well.
common_questions.description_7: Every Fiverr Business freelancer has passed a multi-layered screening process combining AI and professional hand-vetting to cultivate your quality assurance.
common_questions.description_8: All of the saved freelancers will be available in the Freelancers page at the Navigation Bar, as well as within Lists.

advanced_handover_capabilities.label: Advanced handover capabilities
advanced_handover_capabilities.tooltip: Control when and how your assistant hands the conversation over to you, and get a conversation summary to help you continue smoothly.

availability.label: Scheduled availability
availability.tooltip: Schedule your assistant's availability down to the hour, so every client inquiry gets an immediate response — even when you’re away.

chat_behavior_control.label: Chat behavior control
chat_behavior_control.tooltip: Set your assistant’s role in delivering business information to clients — from discussing your services, to presenting packages, and handing the conversation to you.

check_in_chats_with_clients.label: Check-in chats with clients
check_in_chats_with_clients.tooltip: Your assistant will reconnect with clients who showed interest in you, picking up the conversation where they left off, and adding helpful context.

complete_customization.label: Complete customization
complete_customization.tooltip: Take control of your assistant — personalize each service and choose how it’s shown to clients.

conversation_summary.label: Handoff with actionable summary
conversation_summary.tooltip: Your assistant will create a brief after each client conversation —summarizing key points, capturing client details, and suggesting next steps.

dedicated_assistant_training.label: Dedicated assistant training
dedicated_assistant_training.tooltip: Shape your assistant’s communication style — its responses to questions, the info it shares, and how it presents you and your services.

enhanced_response_rate_when_active.label: Enhanced response rate when active
enhanced_response_rate_when_active.tooltip: Your assistant will respond instantly to client inquiries — answering questions, and moving the conversation forward with zero wait time.

file_and_link_analysis.label: Smart file and link analysis
file_and_link_analysis.tooltip: Your assistant will analyze attached files and shared links to extract key details, helping it respond to your clients more accurately.

improved_visibility_in_search.label: Improved visibility in search
improved_visibility_in_search.tooltip: Your assistant will appear in more searches, helping you get discovered and attract more clients.

multiple_languages.label: Multi-language support
multiple_languages.tooltip: Set the languages your assistant can use — it will adapt automatically based on client requests.

performance_analytics.label: Performance analytics
performance_analytics.tooltip: Evaluate your assistant’s impact through the analytics dashboard, and use the insights to fine-tune its behavior for even better results.

widgets_highlight_key_seller_info.label: Widgets that highlight key seller info
widgets_highlight_key_seller_info.tooltip: Your assistant will share your portfolio and packages (widgets) at the right moment in the client conversation to increase engagement, and guide the client toward a sale.

common_questions.description_1: Registering your business and adding team members is free. You only pay for the services you order—just like on Fiverr.
common_questions.description_2: You can get a shortlist of handpicked freelancers from a dedicated Business Success Manager or just post a brief.
common_questions.description_3: Nope! A single account can be made for and shared by multiple users. Whether you’re working solo or collaborating with others, our vetted talent is available for all.
common_questions.description_4: Once you switch to a Fiverr Business account, it becomes your only default account. Everything will move with you, including previous searches, saved freelancers and inbox messages.
common_questions.description_5: Your existing balance will be refunded to your original payment method and your order history will move with you.
common_questions.description_6: Of course! You can deactivate your Fiverr Business account and go back to the Fiverr account. All of your information will be transferred as well.
common_questions.description_7: Every Fiverr Business freelancer has passed a multi-layered screening process combining AI and professional hand-vetting to cultivate your quality assurance.
common_questions.description_8: All of the saved freelancers will be available in the Freelancers page at the Navigation Bar, as well as within Lists.

common_questions.description_1: Registering your business and adding team members is free. You only pay for the services you order—just like on Fiverr.
common_questions.description_2: You can get a shortlist of handpicked freelancers from a dedicated Business Success Manager or just post a brief.
common_questions.description_3: Nope! A single account can be made for and shared by multiple users. Whether you’re working solo or collaborating with others, our vetted talent is available for all.
common_questions.description_4: Once you switch to a Fiverr Business account, it becomes your only default account. Everything will move with you, including previous searches, saved freelancers and inbox messages.
common_questions.description_5: Your existing balance will be refunded to your original payment method and your order history will move with you.
common_questions.description_6: Of course! You can deactivate your Fiverr Business account and go back to the Fiverr account. All of your information will be transferred as well.
common_questions.description_7: Every Fiverr Business freelancer has passed a multi-layered screening process combining AI and professional hand-vetting to cultivate your quality assurance.
common_questions.description_8: All of the saved freelancers will be available in the Freelancers page at the Navigation Bar, as well as within Lists.

description.content:
WELCOME TO MY FIGMA TO FRAMER OR WEBFLOW EXPERT GIG,

Are you seeking a skilled Framer/Webflow/Wix certified expert to transform your Figma designs into fully functional, responsive websites? Look no further!


What I Can Do for You:

My Services:

  • Figma to Framer development or Webflow design or Wix
  • Fully responsive site development with Framer or Webflow
  • Framer/Webflow CMS integration for powerful content management
  • Customize your Framer/Webflow Template
  • Plugin integration for added functionality

Framer Stunning Animations:

  • Smooth scroll animations
  • Interactive components (Hover, Press, Drag, Loop effects)
  • Framer text effects and tickers
  • Creative visual effects

Website Features:

  • Framer Landing page design
  • Framer blog or business site
  • Framer portfolio site
  • E-commerce site development
  • Contact forms and localization
  • Ongoing maintenance and support


Why Choose Me?

High-Quality Results: I prioritize pixel-perfect design and flawless functionality.

Fast Turnaround: Delivering your project on time is my priority.

Reliable Communication: I ensure smooth collaboration at every step.


"To view my portfolio, please visit my Fiverr gig and explore the showcased projects in the Framer/Webflow

questionsAndAnswers.answer: Yes, I will design your website to be fully responsive, ensuring it looks great and functions perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
questionsAndAnswers.question: Will the website be fully responsive?

questionsAndAnswers.answer: To begin, I'll need your Figma design files, any specific instructions or requirements you have, and access to any tools or platforms you'd like integrated, such as Zapier, HubSpot, or Google Analytics.
questionsAndAnswers.question: What do you need from me to start the project?

questionsAndAnswers.answer: The timeline depends on the complexity and size of the project. Typically, a standard Figma to Framer conversion takes about 5-7 days. However, I offer faster delivery options if you need it sooner.
questionsAndAnswers.question: How long does it take to convert a Figma file into a Framer site?

questionsAndAnswers.answer: Absolutely! I can integrate essential tools such as Mailchimp for email marketing, HubSpot for CRM, and Zapier for workflow automation, among others, to streamline your business processes.
questionsAndAnswers.question: Can you integrate third-party tools like Mailchimp, HubSpot, or Zapier?

questionsAndAnswers.answer: Custom Framer development includes building unique features, implementing complex layouts, and tailoring the website to meet your specific business needs. I can also handle advanced integrations and functionality based on your requirements.
questionsAndAnswers.question: What is included in the custom Framer development service?

questionsAndAnswers.answer: Yes, I offer ongoing support and maintenance services to ensure your website continues to function smoothly. You can reach out to me for any updates, troubleshooting, or additional features.
questionsAndAnswers.question: Do you provide ongoing support after the site is live?

reviews.comment:
I had a great experience working with this freelancer. From the very beginning, communication was smooth and professional. He always responded incredibly quickly, which made the whole process efficient and stress-free.

What really stood out to me is how well he understood exactly what I was looking for. I barely had to explain anything twice—he just got it right away. That level of understanding and attention to detail is rare and made a huge difference in the final result.

The quality of the work exceeded my expectations, and you can clearly see that he puts real effort and care into what he does. On top of that, his service is simply outstanding—friendly, reliable, and very committed to delivering the best possible outcome.

I would absolutely recommend him to anyone looking for high-quality work and excellent service. Without a doubt, I will be coming back for future projects!

I have used fiverr multiple times, this is by far my worst experience with a freelancer.  

The order was delayed by a week. I had to point out corrections multiple times before they were adjusted properly. It was a horrible experience

seller_response.comment: He asked for more than the project requirements he originally shared, and he kept demanding extra things. Worst experience ever.

I highly recommend him for any website you want especially if you have a picturesque vision in mind, as he will absolutely deliver it perfectly.
I just needed little fixes to my website as i was not familiar with framer, Kafy managed to help me swiftly and even give me suggestion on how to make my site look better. 10/10 would recommend!
Builds pretty good websites for the price. The creativity and visual appeal isn't mind blowing. but he does a good job for the price. and his communication and responsiveness is on point
